title: Thread: Update for Thread version 1.2 and 1.3 along with TREL
description:
* TREL dissector added `packet-trel.c`, new key generation function is added in `packet-ieee802154.c` specific to TREL
* Also added some TLV changes like supervision TLV in `packet-mle.c` code
* modified coap proto so that it understand that given data is from thread network.
